headline: UFO Moviez India Limited: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4)
sum: UFO Moviez India Limited filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulation 31(4), signalling a substantial acquisition of shares or an open offer event requiring exchange and public notice.
detail: UFO Moviez India Limited submitted a formal disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure is the first public notice of a proposed substantial acquisition or takeover. The specific acquirer identity, consideration, timeline and conditions are embedded in the full disclosure document (typically a .pdf or .zip archive filed with the exchange). Regulation 31(4) requires the acquirer to disclose: (i) details of the acquirer, (ii) the quantity and price of shares, (iii) funding sources, (iv) conditions precedent, and (v) any conflicts or regulatory approvals required.
